rows.itemTitle: RENEWAL TERMINATION TRANSFER AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
rows.summary: Between the 2022 and 2026 FDDs, Item 17 increased renewal and successor-term advance notice from 120 to 210 days and overhauled dispute resolution: the arbitration/litigation forum moved from Maricopa County, Arizona to the county and state of the franchised business, a single qualified attorney-arbitrator was required, a class action waiver and franchisee venue/jury-trial waiver were added, the franchisor gained forum discretion for excluded disputes, the right to appeal arbitrator awards over $100,000 was removed, and governing law changed from Arizona to the state where the business/premises is located.

Arizona law applies
